title: Reproducibility code and data for structural kinetic analysis of hepatic polyamine metabolism
description: Python code, three BioModels SBML inputs, and derived numerical data supporting structural-kinetic, substrate-gain, MAT-capacity/throughput control, continuation, robustness, asymptotic substrate-saturation, and regulatory-bistability analyses of hepatic polyamine metabolism. This archive is a reproducibility object only and does not contain the article manuscript or supplementary material.
notes: Release v1.0.0, frozen after the manuscript v9 audit. Manuscript and supplementary article files are intentionally excluded. BioModels SBML inputs are CC0; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
